title: Accessible lodging: compare two providers and wait for on-site measurement
brief: Choose between Hostel A and Hotel B for two nights, November 14-16, with a CNY 2600 budget. The wheelchair is 78cm wide; both the doorway and bathroom clear widths must be at least 80cm. Obtain measured dimensions and confirm the suitable hotel's availability and total price. Do not book.

pages.title: Candidate accommodation overview
pages.text: Hostel A's old webpage claims an 88cm doorway; Hotel B also has accessible rooms. Both receptions work daily, while facilities staff have separate schedules. Hotel B schedules accessibility remeasurement for the designated room type close to arrival. Hotel B's accessible room description and other documents are attached to this page.
pages.snippet: Overview of both accommodation candidates and on-site measurement arrangements.

documents.title: Hotel B accessible room description.pdf
documents.text: Hotel B accessible room description: according to the record holder's understanding, the clear doorway width is 96cm. (Compiled by the record holder.)

pages.title: Candidate accommodation contacts
pages.text: Lan Xin at Hostel A reception; Mi He for Hotel B booking inquiries. Each property's facilities staff handle on-site measurements.

pages.title: Accessible accommodation booking portal
pages.text: Accessible accommodation booking information: provide wheelchair width and stay dates to confirm an accessible room at Hostel A or Hotel B. Access dimensions require on-site remeasurement. Obtain Hotel B's date-specific availability and total price through this page's registration form. This page only explains requirements and cannot book online.
pages.snippet: Hostel A and Hotel B accessible room confirmation requirements; no online booking.

form.title: Date-specific room availability and quote check registration
form.submit_instructions: This form cannot be submitted directly online. Use the hotel room availability and quote check channel; see the latest official overview page notice for the channel name and acceptance schedule.

authorization: Only communicate, make inquiries, check status, supply materials already held, and obtain written confirmation. Do not pay, place orders, sign contracts, or make formal business commitments.

answer_format.summary: A natural-language summary stating the conclusion and its basis accurately, including key elements of receipts obtained during the process, such as identifiers, quantities, amounts, dates, and units. answer_keys lists information the summary should cover; separate itemized answers are not required. Do not fabricate, exaggerate, or cite evidence identifiers absent from the receipts.
